theory.text: Short-answer questions require brief facts from the passage. Diagram Label Completion requires matching descriptions in the passage to components or positions shown in a diagram. Respect the specified word limit.
Key skills: Scanning for exact names, positions and components.

guide.text: Read each question or missing diagram label  identify the required object or location  scan for the description  verify it in context  supply only the requested words.

small.text: Text: “A thermometer was placed inside the central chamber to measure temperature.”
Answer using NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS.E1. What instrument measured temperature?E2. Where was the instrument placed?

full.text: The water filter consists of three layers. At the top, coarse gravel catches larger particles. Fine sand sits below the gravel and traps smaller material. Activated charcoal forms the bottom layer and reduces unwanted odours. Filtered water then leaves through a narrow outlet pipe.
Answer using NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS from the passage.1. What catches larger particles?2. Which layer is beneath the gravel?3. What reduces unwanted odours?4. What carries filtered water out?
